# Affreso

**Church management, free and yours.**

Affreso is a free, open-source church management system for churches of every size and language: members and households, pastoral care and prayer, volunteer rosters, children’s check-in, events, forms and giving.

It runs on ordinary PHP + MySQL hosting that your church controls, so your congregation’s information stays with you.

- 🌐 Website and tutorials: https://affreso.com
- ▶️ Live demo: https://demo.affreso.com
- 📦 Download: https://affreso.com/download/
- 💬 Help us translate, test or improve it: see [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/affreso/affreso/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
